name: Property Report
description: Real estate property analysis covering market context, comparables, pricing, neighborhood data, and investment potential

sections.title: Property Overview
sections.purpose: Provide a comprehensive summary of the subject property including address, property type, lot size, square footage, bedrooms/bathrooms, year built, condition, and notable features.

sections.title: Market Context
sections.purpose: Describe the local real estate market conditions including median home prices, inventory levels, days on market, and year-over-year trends for the area. Include relevant area statistics.

sections.title: Comparable Sales Analysis
sections.purpose: Present recently sold comparable properties with details on sale price, size, condition, and proximity. Analyze adjustments for differences and derive a value range for the subject property.

sections.title: Price Analysis
sections.purpose: Analyze price per square foot trends in the area, historical price appreciation, and current listing vs. sale price ratios. Compare the subject property's pricing to local benchmarks.

sections.title: Neighborhood Profile
sections.purpose: Profile the surrounding neighborhood including school ratings and proximity, crime statistics, walkability scores, public transit access, nearby amenities (shopping, dining, parks), and demographic data.

sections.title: Permit & Construction Activity
sections.purpose: Summarize recent building permits, planned developments, and construction activity in the area. Highlight any projects that may positively or negatively impact property values.

sections.title: Investment Analysis
sections.purpose: Evaluate the property as an investment including estimated rental income, cap rate, cash-on-cash return, ROI projections, and break-even analysis. Consider both short-term and long-term scenarios.

sections.title: Sources
sections.purpose: List all data sources used in the report including MLS data, public records, census data, school rating providers, crime databases, and any other references with access dates.
